hero.summary: Use authentic medium and medium-hard GMAT wording. For each new pattern, learn the rule, wording translation, fastest method, safe backup, and common trap—then recycle it later without naming the topic.

topics.name: Percentages
topics.status: mastered enough for now · reverse, successive changes, multipliers, mental shortcuts and applied business questions

topics.name: Ratios & proportions
topics.status: strong foundation · increasingly applied inside multi-step algebra, totals and subgroup problems

topics.name: Fractions
topics.status: foundation mastered · operations, simplifying and applied word-problem practice ongoing

topics.name: Multi-step word problems
topics.status: improving · high priority · use x → solve first group → ratio → second-group total → leftover; use a 2×2 matrix when wording is crowded

topics.name: Algebra
topics.status: in progress · translating authentic wording into equations and combining algebra with ratios and totals

topics.name: Rates / distance
topics.status: started · D = R × T, head starts and combined meeting speed

topics.name: Work-rate problems
topics.status: stronger · inverse time/rate wording newly learned and needs recycling · if time M:N = 3:4, rate M:N = 4:3

topics.name: Rate × quantity = total
topics.status: introduced and understood · connect workers × output, units × price, distance, work, production and payroll; needs disguised application

topics.name: Weighted averages
topics.status: in progress · formula setup is good; transfer across different unknowns and disguised wording needs practice

recommendations.title: Weighted-average transfer
recommendations.detail: Vary the unknown: subgroup size, subgroup average, overall average, group-size ratio, and before/after group changes. Do not repeat identical templates.

recommendations.title: Inverse time/rate recognition
recommendations.detail: Recycle the reciprocal ratio shortcut inside disguised work-rate problems; keep the full fractional equation as a backup.

recommendations.title: Multi-step algebra + ratio + totals
recommendations.detail: Use authentic business scenarios and the x → first group → ratio → second-group total → leftover sequence.

recommendations.title: Complete averages and weighted averages
recommendations.detail: Teach the high-yield rule, wording translation, fastest method, backup method, and common traps.

recommendations.title: Move toward number properties
recommendations.detail: After recognition becomes reliable, begin the next high-yield Quant area with mostly medium and medium-hard questions.
